rows.sourceNote: Physical residence and residential address retained. Ownership is not required; intransitive suru recognized without replacing the practical noun examples.
Payment collection distinguished from saving and donation. Transitive/intransitive suru patterns and same-headword collected-money public definition recognized.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source gathering/assembly and mathematical-set identity.
rows.sourceNote: Practical intransitive gathering pattern taught; mathematical set requires determined membership. Actual gathering events and organizations are not made a transitive synonym clique.
Pen and brush practice recognized, not brush-only. The character/handwriting family 1315130:2 is inspected directly rather than treating its primary card title as exhaustive.
Transitive suru with the repaired item marked by wo. Attested roof repair prevents a rigid clothing-only rule or machine-versus-clothing division with 修理.
Illness and injury can cause the condition. Same-family 重態 recognized. 渋滞 is a distinct homophone, not a reusable article or semantic synonym.
Carpet/rug/runner recognized. Rare 絨緞 is distinguished from search-only 絨氈 and katakana forms; character fabric associations do not impose wool-only materials.
Endpoint is not arrival or the last train of the day. Public mathematical endpoint is a qualified recognition note, not an invented extra JMdict index.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source important-point/emphasis and colon identity.
rows.sourceNote: N ni juuten wo oku taught explicitly. Punctuation recognition is source-qualified: JMdict colon sense 3 is not disproved by the inspected public entry's different inventory. Iteration-mark sense 2 is additional without an independent N2 assignment.
Intransitive suru with the post marked by ni; distinguish starting employment, ceremonial inauguration and software installation.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source circumference/surroundings and computer-peripheral identity.
rows.sourceNote: Vicinity, geometric boundary and surrounding circumstances qualified. Peripheral devices recognized in 周辺機器. Actual 周 and 辺 reciprocal links added; unrelated 回り is not inferred from a baseline comparison mistake.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source company-director/executive identity at じゅうやく.
rows.sourceNote: Important post/responsibility is additional. Executive sense 1 is restricted to じゅうやく; obsolete おもやく does not inherit that sense. Distinguish the person from the role and a film director.
Transitive and intransitive suru patterns taught. Ending need not certify successful completion; meeting closure overlaps 閉じる without equating every physical shutting or reasoned conclusion.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source weight identity; raw heavyweight-boxer gloss not licensed for the bare noun.
rows.sourceNote: Pinned 1336900 has only weight. Separate 1938040 and 1968070 support heavyweight class, not a boxer-person sense. Ordinary luggage weighing is distinguished from a complete physics definition. Primary 量 backlink added.
Physics noun distinguished from heavy adjective, weight and mass. 引力 includes but is not restricted to gravitational attraction; no numerical physics claims added.

rows.mappingNote: Exact source kanji-compound and idiomatic-expression identity.
rows.sourceNote: Kanji compounds need not be nonliteral or four characters. Character association explicitly labeled a modern aid, not historical etymology.

Calendar holiday distinguished from personal leave and consecutive days off. 祭日 overlap recognized without a rigid present-day calendar split; actual おやすみ includes day-off/rest senses. Primary 祝 backlink added.
Transitive/intransitive suru and size/scale reduction taught. Image dimensions are not automatically data compression; 縮少 remains search-only.
Especially entrance examinations; exam or institution as transitive object. Taking is not passing or merely preparing. 受験生 may name a candidate before the exam.
Non-agent predicate example, recoverable omission and topic-versus-subject contrast. Basic ga analysis is qualified for framework differences; not every English subject means 主語.

quizGuardRationale: Author hypotheses for independent assessment. Direct ordinary meanings and actual labels govern; symmetric, nontransitive guards are not unrestricted Japanese substitution rules.

住居 guards actual residence/house/address labels, including own/honorific home, rental house and boarding lodging. Family life and the action of an overnight stay do not automatically name the residential place.

集金 guards 集める's broad collecting action, not every donation, saving transaction or collection hobby. 集合 guards direct meeting-up/assembly/event and general set meanings; an organization, crowd or building is not inherited through an event synonym.
習字 guards 字's explicit handwriting/penmanship sense 1315130:2 and 練習's broad practice label. Reading characters or learning every subject is not automatically penmanship.
修繕 guards direct physical 修理/直す repair meanings. Correcting a plan or improving conditions alone does not establish physical mending.

重体 has no curated guard: 渋滞 is only a homophone, 症状 concerns symptoms and 病気 does not itself express critical severity. 絨毯 has no guard against tatami merely because both cover floors; カーペット has no existing article.

終点 guards endpoint/end/finish labels 終わり/最後/末/ゴール, not every intermediate stop, arrival event or last train. 重点 guards direct important-point/emphasis/priority labels, not every item called important or a physical point.

就任 guards 就く's actual taking-a-post meaning, not obtaining employment in general. 重役 guards president as a specific company executive and the direct important role/post overlap with 役/役割, not a film director.

周辺 guards direct vicinity/surroundings/circumference/environment labels. 回り's actual rotation/rounds/spreading family is not turned into surroundings by an inaccurate pre-existing comparison; geometric circumference overlap with 円周 is direct but not unrestricted.

終了 guards actual ending/finishing/completion and event/acceptance/connection-ending uses in the listed complete families. It does not automatically guard every physical door closure or a reasoned 結論. Ending a process is not a guarantee of a successful completed product.

重量 has no guard against 量's general amount/quantity label; weight is not automatically every quantity. 重力 guards 引力's direct gravitational-attraction sense, without equating every attraction with gravity.

熟語 guards 単語/言葉 broad word/expression labels; being a compound does not require a nonliteral idiom. 祝日 guards actual public-holiday/day-off senses of 祭日/休日/休み/おやすみ; personal leave and consecutive days alone do not establish a public holiday.

縮小 guards direct reducing/decreasing and compression/condensing overlap. Data compression is 1153080:3, separate from physical compression and shortening; image resizing and data compression are not identical operations.
受験 guards 受ける's actual taking-an-exam use, not the noun naming the exam or passing it. 主語 has no guard against discussion topic or school subject merely because English uses subject for both.
